name: Action Menu
job: Put every way to get or discuss one document behind a single header button, each item named by format and purpose.

anatomy.role: One word plus a chevron (Agreement ▾), no other icon; 44px tall, sans 600
Opens below the trigger, right-aligned, at least 17rem wide
Label left reading `format, for purpose`; action icon right (download, or new tab for an external link)
The last item, solid fill, same label-left icon-right layout
The same items under a small heading, placed in the hamburger panel at 560px and below

states.name: Closed
states.note: Only the trigger shows; `aria-expanded` is false.

states.name: Open
states.note: Three items then the solid call to action. Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

states.name: Phone, in the hamburger
states.note: At 560px and below the trigger leaves the header; the same list sits under the tabs in the hamburger panel.

use_when: One document has several ways to be taken away (print, edit, comment) plus one conversation to start about it.
Labels read `format, for purpose`: PDF, for print · Word, for counsel · Google Doc, for comments. The reader picks by what they will do, not by file type.
The call to action (Discuss) is the solid last item with the same layout, so the eye ends on it.
Header placement above 560px; at 560px and below the group moves into the hamburger panel under the tabs.
avoid_when: There is only one action: show a plain button instead of a menu of one.
Do not add dotted leaders, a second icon on the trigger, or a description line under each item.
Do not put the icon on the left; the label leads and the icon only says what clicking does.
Do not move the trigger into the hamburger at the tab-collapse width; it moves only at 560px and below.

data.note: `text` reads `format, for purpose`; `kind` is `download` or `external` and picks the icon and the `download` or `target` attribute.
Longer accessible name, such as `PDF, for print: download the agreement`; external links add `(opens in a new tab)`.
The solid last item, such as `Discuss` linking to a booking page.

access: Trigger is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the panel is a plain list of links, not a `role=menu`, so links keep their native keyboard and screen-reader behaviour.
Opening moves focus to the first item; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; a click outside closes it.
Icons are `aria-hidden`; each link's accessible name carries the format, the purpose and a new-tab warning when it applies.
Every item is 44px tall; focus ring is a 2px cyan outline. Sizes are rem, so the reading options scale it.
The phone group is a `role=group` labelled with the trigger word.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
